name: dev_iot_monitoring
description: Event-driven IoT monitoring application with non-human primary actors.
resource_constraints_text: Deploy Docker containers on AWS Linux VMs in the Seoul region with a 700 USD monthly budget. Use at least 8 vCPUs in total. Short ingestion peaks are expected.

classified.text: Operators register devices with a unique identifier and authentication credential.
Registered Sensors submit timestamped temperature and humidity observations.
Operators view the latest observations and connectivity state for each device.
Operators define threshold rules for a device or device group.
When a threshold is crossed, the system asks the external Message Delivery Provider to deliver an alert to the responsible Operator.
Operators query historical observations by device and time range.
Devices retrieve their current sampling interval and threshold configuration.
The service shall ingest 2,000 observations per second with a 95th-percentile latency below one second.
Observations shall be retained for 90 days and survive application or VM restarts.
Duplicate observation identifiers shall not create duplicate records.
Device and provider credentials shall be supplied at runtime.
The application shall run in Docker containers on Linux VMs and expose ingestion health metrics.
